Though the lands to the west are more mountainous, the cave that is run beneath the hills of this region as dark as any in Caledon, and within any ancient Dragons slumber within them. In ages past, Dragons were both warriors and nobles, and they might travel outside the lands of the High Elves came under this threat, the Dragon Princes traveled to this land to rouse the slumbering beasts to war.

It is believed that the teachings and rituals are highly secret and they are only transferred from a Loremaster to a Loremaster.
